title: Validation and Standardization of RT-PCR Techniques for Cassava Brown Streak Virus Detection
author: Hamza, Ahmad Balarabe
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Collect symptomatic leaf samples
steps.instruction: Collect cassava leaf samples displaying typical CBSD symptoms from fields in Mozambique, Tanzania, and Uganda.

steps.title: Extract RNA with modified CTAB
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA from the collected leaf tissue using the modified cetyl trimethylammonium bromide (CTAB) protocol as performed at the Natural Resource Institute (NRI).

steps.title: Perform RT‑PCR with CBSV primers
steps.instruction: Use the extracted RNA as template for reverse transcription‑polymerase chain reaction (RT‑PCR) with the following primer pairs: CBSV 10 and 11 to amplify partial coat protein sequences, and CBSV 9 and 11 to amplify full‑length coat protein sequences.

substeps.instruction: Set up RT‑PCR reaction with CBSV 10 and 11 primers to target partial coat protein
Set up RT‑PCR reaction with CBSV 9 and 11 primers to target full‑length coat protein
